title: Bin El Ouidane reservoir on 20 Oct 2026
summary: On 20 Oct 2026 the radar shows a lake of 28.52 km2 inside the 10 km circle around Bin El Ouidane. This date carries a flag for a backscatter shift, so its values are less reliable than those of an unflagged date.

sections.heading: What the radar shows here

sections.text: Trees, shrub and rugged slopes cover 192.98 km2 and give HV of -11.96 dB, the brightest of the large types, from leaves and branches. sections.heading: Data quality notes
sections.text: One flag applies: backscatter over built-up land shifted more than 0.5 dB from its June-September median, a possible processing offset or widespread wet conditions. Possible cause: rain wetting soil and walls. Possible cause: a processing offset. Rain records and reprocessed files would settle it.
